verses.t: “Assatthe haritobhāse, saṁvirūḷhamhi pādape; Ekaṁ buddhagataṁ saññaṁ, alabhitthaṁ patissato.
Ekatiṁse ito kappe, yaṁ saññamalabhiṁ tadā; Tassā saññāya vāhasā, patto me āsavakkhayo”ti. … Sandhito thero … vaggo pañcamo.
Kumārakassapo thero, dhammapālo ca brahmāli; Mogharājā visākho ca, cūḷako ca anūpamo; Vajjito sandhito thero, kilesarajavāhanoti. Dukanipāto niṭṭhito.
Gāthādukanipātamhi, navuti ceva aṭṭha ca; Therā ekūnapaññāsaṁ, bhāsitā nayakovidāti.
